node.title: Re^5: Inclusion of Raku on PerlMonks
node.author: 1nickt
node.doctext:
Sigh. I've been following the Rakudists' debate for months. I'm not sure what your agenda is either in flogging the dead horse of "Raku is Perl" or in repeating old, irrelevant and untrue accusations about me (with links!) That post has 30 upvotes fyi. And your command of English is quite excellent enough to see that I made no mention there of hatred, simply asked the Rakudists to stand on their own two feet.

Which they are now doing.

You are trying to paint me with a broad and inaccurate brush. Why?

Are you sure your advocacy of Raku isn't misplaced and outside of what the Rakudists themselves are seeking?

Update: also just fyi I'm not interested in verbal jousting or circular wordplay masquerading as sophomoric "debate":

why would we think that even they would welcome such a mention here?

See the text I quoted.

I don't think you can interpret that small quote as seeking inclusion.

I never claimed that, it was a counterpoint to your post.

As I said, sigh ...


The way forward always starts with a minimal test.
